title: Adaptive operator selection for differential evolution, with the uniform-random ablation
description: Five adaptive operator-selection policies over a shared pool of five differential-evolution mutation operators, compared against the individual fixed operators, a uniform-random ablation over the identical pool, a post-hoc hindsight oracle, and JADE as an external published reference. On 24 noiseless BBOB functions at D in {5, 20} with 25 runs and a hard-enforced budget of 500 x D evaluations, all five policies beat uniform random selection at D=5 and none beat it at D=20, where two significantly lose. The chosen baseline alone determines the reported headline. Friedman, Holm-corrected Wilcoxon and Cliff's delta throughout.
